applies_to.quote: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – RRBs dated October 17, 2018

answer.action: No action is required as the notification repeals earlier relief measure directions for regional rural banks, which are replaced by other specified amendment directions.
answer.action_quote: hereby repeals Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – RRBs dated October 17, 2018

effective_date.quote: The Directions shall be replaced with the fol lowing Directions issued on April 29, 2026, with effect from July 01, 2026.

answer.amends: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – RRBs
